note: Rows that extend plan v7 Appendix B's Java public-type disposition table after the plan was frozen. The plan file itself is not edited, because pre-m0/registry-linter.mjs pins its digest; each row names the numbered amendment (planning/M-R-STATUS.md) that decided it. scripts/java-surface-audit.mjs reads Appendix B and these rows together, refuses a row that duplicates an Appendix B row, and fails on a row whose type is no longer public Java API.

rows.disposition: No JavaScript counterpart. lokalized-js always takes IANA language-range equivalences from the pinned registry, which is Java's default IANA_REGISTRY setting, and offers no JDK setting: JavaScript has no JDK, so such a setting could only ever mean JDK 21.
